component.name: Fun Racer
component.summary: Race on real circuits rebuilt from open map data

description.p: Fun Racer is a free racing game about real places. Every circuit is rebuilt from open map, elevation and survey data: the corners, the climbs and the run-off areas are where they are in real life, and the scenery around them comes from the same open sources.

ul.li: Grand Prix series: the circuits of a modern world championship calendar, from street tracks to classic road courses
Endurance series with a prototype car, including the full Le Mans lap and the Nordschleife through the forest
Arcade handling that is easy to pick up, or an optional simulation model with tyres, suspension, aerodynamics and a hybrid power unit
Time attack against your own ghost, or races against up to seven bots
Records with best laps and sectors for every track
Keyboard and gamepad, with every binding configurable
Use your phone as a steering wheel over the local Wi-Fi: no app to install, just scan a code
A realistic track look with scanned materials and real skies, and a lighter look for older laptops

description.p: Fun Racer is made to run well on modest hardware such as laptops with integrated graphics. It has no ads, no accounts and no online services.
